name: AI SLO and behavior drift monitor
description: Repeatedly assess AI quality, safety, latency, and cost against a fixed baseline. Connects an existing structured AI evaluator; OpenOrbit retains the evidence, supervision, and improvement decisions.

parameters.label: Evaluation name
parameters.tooltip: Name the build that OpenOrbit creates for this recurring evaluation.

parameters.label: Evaluator workspace
parameters.tooltip: Absolute path to the local repository or workspace that this evaluation may inspect.

parameters.label: Structured evaluator command
parameters.description: A command that supports preflight, prepare, run-probes, and collect-evidence and returns JSON for each action.
parameters.tooltip: Command OpenOrbit invokes once per probe action. It must return one JSON object to stdout.

parameters.label: SLO focus
parameters.default: response quality, policy compliance, latency, and cost
parameters.placeholder: e.g. grounded answers and p95 latency under 3 seconds
parameters.tooltip: Quality, safety, latency, or cost objectives that the fixed probe matrix should assess.

parameters.label: AI model profile
parameters.tooltip: Select an existing AI model profile, or create one for this build.

runner.name: ${build_name} runner
runner.description: Evidence-gated AI SLO and drift monitor created by Quick Start.

prompt_template.name: ${build_name} policy
prompt_template.content: Review the fixed AI SLO evidence for ${slo_focus}. Compare each reported metric with its retained baseline and threshold. Report only evidence-backed drift, regressions, or risks; propose reversible improvements with explicit validation and rollback steps.

test_case_set.name: ${build_name} probe matrix
test_case_set.description: A fixed, repeatable AI operational SLO probe matrix.

cases.name: AI SLO and behavior drift
cases.prompt: Evaluate ${slo_focus} against the evaluator's fixed representative input matrix.
cases.acceptance: Return structured current metrics, baseline comparisons, configured thresholds, outliers, and reproducible evidence for every detected drift.

build.name: ${build_name}
build.purpose: Continuously monitor AI operational SLOs and behavior drift with retained evidence.
